prospective_state.declaration: Synthetic example only; no scored model call has been executed.

construct.operational_definition: A repair is successful only when deterministic hidden acceptance verifies the declared causal invariant without a critical regression.
construct.target_claim: On the frozen synthetic pack and stack, the prompt change meets the preregistered matched-pair decision rule.
construct.falsifier: The claim is false when the frozen matched-pair threshold is not met or any treatment critical-failure gate fires.

task_quality.construct_alignment: Every task requires a repair whose hidden acceptance checks the declared state-order or boundary-contract invariant.

evaluator_quality.scoring_rule: Run the frozen deterministic acceptance suite and classify a cell only from its exit status and declared critical checks.
evaluator_quality.known_error_profile: The example evaluator can miss defects outside the frozen acceptance surface and has no human inter-rater estimate.
evaluator_quality.adjudication: Any ambiguous or infrastructure-invalid cell stops the study and is not silently scored.

analysis_quality.decision_threshold: At least three favorable matched pairs, zero unfavorable pairs, and zero treatment critical failures.
analysis_quality.missing_invalid_rule: Any missing or invalid cell blocks the terminal effect decision; no outcome retry or imputation is allowed.

uncertainty.method: Report the exact paired outcome table and an exact two-sided interval for the matched binary contrast.

execution_declaration.repeat_rationale: Two frozen repeats expose immediate run instability without pretending to estimate broad transfer.
execution_declaration.order_rationale: Randomize condition order inside task-repeat blocks from a frozen seed and retain the schedule.

reliability.perturbation_plan: No paraphrase perturbation is claimed in this alpha example.
reliability.fault_plan: The calibration includes one plausible shortcut failure; broader fault injection is deferred.
